Introduction

Ju Hak-Nyeon is a South Korean singer, actor, and former member of THE BOYZ. He participated in the survival show Produce 101 season 2, where he finished 19th place.

Haknyeon made his official debut on December 6, 2017, as the vocalist, rapper, and lead dancer of the boy group The Boyz. He made his acting debut in 2022 through the horror anthology film "Seoul Goedam."

One Hundred Label announced that Ju Haknyeon had officially withdrawn from THE BOYZ and terminated his exclusive contract with the company on June 18, 2025. The decision came after reports surfaced linking Haknyeon to a former JAV actress turned influencer, along with media accusations of prostitution. These allegations led to the immediate suspension of his activities. Both Haknyeon and the influencer denied the prostitution claims, and the police later cleared Haknyeon after an anonymous individual filed a complaint based solely on articles they had read online.

On June 20, Haknyeon took to social media to announce that he would be taking legal action against malicious articles as well as his company and clarified that he had neither withdrawn from the group, nor agreed to terminate his exclusive contract with One Hundred. He also stated that the company had not only ignored the proper procedures outlined in his contract, but had also demanded over 2 billion won (approximately 1.46 million USD) and lied to the public about his contract being finalized.
